reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5, curriculum and design work delegated by George
factChecks: Independently recomputed all 106 numeric keys from their problem statements in packages/curriculum/tests/psychology-content.test.ts: 54 lesson questions, 19 recall cards and 33 course-check items. All 13 exact-word answers and 24 recall cards were marked with the shipped text matcher; each of the 8 choice questions has exactly one accepted option.

Checked definitions against OpenStax Psychology 2e sections 2.1, 2.3, 5.1, 6.2, 6.3, 7.3, 8.1, 8.3, 8.4, 12.4 and 12.6 (web pages read on 6 October 2026). The book's current web licence is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, not CC BY 4.0, so it is recorded as reference-only.

Verified by web lookup on 6 October 2026: Burger (2009) 70% against Milgram's 82.5% at 150 V; Watson and Strayer (2010) 5 of 200 supertaskers; Simons and Chabris (1999) about 46% missing the unexpected event; Doyen et al. (2012) and Murre and Dros (2015) findings and their PLOS Creative Commons licences. OpenStax confirmed Milgram's 65%, Asch's conformity figures, Miller's 7±2 and Cowan's 4±1.

Stated from the author's knowledge of the primary literature and recorded as reference-only sources, not re-read in full today: Open Science Collaboration (35 of 97), Hagger et al. 2016 (d = 0.04), Ranehill et al. 2015, Lehr's 16/d², Roediger and Karpicke 2006 (81/75 and 42/56), Tversky and Kahneman 1974 (25 and 45), Jacowitz and Kahneman 1995, Darley and Latané 1968 (85% and 31%), Milgram's proximity variations (16 and 12 of 40), Manning et al. 2007, Philpot et al. 2020 (91% of 219), Fischer et al. 2011, Chase and Simon 1973, Baddeley 1966, Perry 2013.

Read the installed ts-fsrs 5.4.1 source: stability is the interval at which predicted recall reaches 0.9, the default requested retention is 0.9 and the default decay is the FSRS-6 value 0.1542. The lesson teaches the FSRS-4 curve and says how FSRS-6 differs.

Failed or contested findings (ego depletion, power posing, elderly priming, the 38 Genovese witnesses) appear only as cautionary cases. Illustrative data (class demonstrations, the k-word sample, the bat-and-ball groups) are labelled illustrative in the drawings.

Model invariants pass 14 activity-engine tests; the explorer passes 6 component tests covering concealed results, keyboard controls, reduced motion and the check visual. Desktop (1440x900) and phone (390x844) screenshots of every lesson's beats were inspected on a disposable dev stack and led to repairs of hit/false-alarm shading, drawing sizing, chunk boxes, anchor arcs, review labels and tally sizing. The e2e spec was written but not run.
Editorial review is by the authoring agent under delegated authority. There has been no independent human subject review or documented learner trial.
